record.label: Host error mechanism localization
record.summary: The preregistered, independently audited read-only localization is complete on both frames. Host error is born continuously through depth - born fraction 72% at layer 3 falling to 17% at layer 15 - and propagates near-linearly with per-layer gain about 1.03, so the endpoint is about 83% accumulated propagation of mid-depth births. There is no unit structure: top-1% units carry about 1.2% of error and cross-network unit persistence is about zero. Under the frozen conclusion rule the dominant mechanism is fourth-order pair structure: born error correlates +0.335 (13/14 layers) with the quartic residual star row RMS and +0.290 (13/14) with the t=24 Mehler row coupling in the native frame. Row difficulty correlates +0.30 with dropped-CP4 mass and +0.31 with the t=24 coupling. The emitted proposal is the additive pair-series tail extension t=25..30 on the unchanged Q24 state path, materially different from the closed numerically-failed full Q32 rebuild.
record.terminal_criterion: Solved: the frozen-metric receipt and exactly one graph-ready targeted host-improvement proposal exist with exact hashes; no host modification occurred inside this node.
